pages.text: Writes a value on the screens and starts a new line.

The text appears on every display, laptop and tablet bound to the program and function. Strings are printed without quotes, BOOLEAN values as $(1)TRUE$() and $(1)FALSE$(). Arrays, hashes and structs are printed as JSON. To print several values on one line, join them with ⊕. Without a bound screen, PRINT does nothing.
$(li)$(1)value$() any type: the value to print
